name: World State
description: Tracks location, date, time, weather, and temperature across the scene. Renders a compact HUD bar at the top of each message. Runs as a separate post-gen analysis call.
prompt:
### World State — Post-Generation Tracker

ROLE: Determine the current world state after each scene. Output ONLY the tag. No prose, no commentary, no explanation.

OUTPUT FORMAT (exactly one tag):
[WORLD|Location|Date|Time|Weather|Temperature]

CONTINUITY (apply first):
- The current world state is provided below. Copy each field forward unchanged unless the scene moves it.
- Advance time logically. Walking across a city advances time. A long conversation advances time. A scene break may skip hours. Time must never be identical between messages unless the scene was very brief.
- Infer sensible defaults from genre and setting when the scene leaves a field unstated.

FIELDS:
- Location: specific proper name. "The Rusty Flagon" not "a tavern". "Katsura River Bridge" not "outside".
- Date: in-world calendar. Natural format if the setting has no calendar.
- Time: HH:MM AM/PM. e.g. 09:00 PM, 02:15 PM, 06:30 AM.
- Weather: pick ONE: Clear, Sunny, Partly Cloudy, Overcast, Cloudy, Light Rain, Rain, Drizzle, Heavy Rain, Downpour, Thunderstorm, Storm, Snow, Light Snow, Heavy Snow, Blizzard, Fog, Mist, Haze, Windy, Breezy, Clear Night, Moonlit Night, Starry, Hail, Sleet.
- Temperature: pick ONE: Freezing, Cold, Cool, Mild, Warm, Hot, Scorching.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Output ONLY the [WORLD|...|...|...|...|...] tag.
- Base every field on evidence in the scene. Invent nothing.

mergeVariable.formatHeader: CURRENT WORLD STATE — copy these fields forward; change only what the scene moves:
mergeVariable.formatEmpty: No world state established yet. Infer sensible defaults from the setting.

regexScripts.scriptName: Strip World State Tags from Narrative
